class.name: OIPComms
class.brief_description: The OIPComms singleton is a communications API for PLCs and OPC UA servers. It uses [code]libtagplc[/code] and [code]open62541[/code] as the underlying libraries. The repository and build instructions for this GDextension DLL can be found [url=https://github.com/bikemurt/OIP_gdext]here[/url].

method.name: clear_tag_groups

method.name: register_tag
method.description: Register a tag to a [code]tag_group_name[/code]. The tag group must be registered prior to registering the tag. The format of [code]tag_name[/code] depends on the protocol of the tag group: [b]EtherNet/IP ([code]ab_eip[/code]):[/b] A CIP tag name as defined in the PLC program (e.g. [code]MyTag[/code], [code]Program:MainProgram.MyTag[/code], [code]myUDT.field[/code], [code]myArray[0][/code]). [b]Modbus TCP ([code]modbus_tcp[/code]):[/b] A register type prefix followed by the register number: [code]co[/code] (coil), [code]di[/code] (discrete input), [code]hr[/code] (holding register), or [code]ir[/code] (input register). For example: [code]hr0[/code], [code]co21[/code]. [b]OPC UA ([code]opc_ua[/code]):[/b] The full OPC UA node ID in standard notation. Use [code]ns=X;i=Y[/code] or [code]ns=X;s=Y[/code] with a numeric namespace index, or [code]nsu=URI;i=Y[/code] or [code]nsu=URI;s=Y[/code] with a namespace URI. For example: [code]ns=2;i=12345[/code], [code]ns=2;s=MyVariable[/code], or [code]nsu=CODESYSSPV3/3S/IecVarAccess;s=|var|MyApp.PLC_PRG.myVar[/code]. [b]Beckhoff ADS ([code]ads[/code]):[/b] A symbol path as it appears in the TwinCAT runtime, e.g. [code]MAIN.fbMotor.bRunning[/code] or [code]GVL_IO.iCounter[/code]. Only scalar primitive types (BOOL, BYTE/SINT/USINT, INT/UINT, DINT/UDINT, LINT/ULINT, REAL, LREAL) are supported. [b]Universal Robots RTDE ([code]rtde[/code]):[/b] A variable name from UR's RTDE vocabulary, e.g. [code]actual_q[0][/code], [code]runtime_state[/code], [code]input_int_register_0[/code]. Vector fields use [code]name[index][/code] syntax. Names beginning with [code]input_[/code] are routed to the input recipe and are writable; everything else is read-only. [b]MQTT ([code]mqtt[/code]):[/b] The MQTT topic that this tag subscribes to and publishes on, e.g. [code]sensors/temp1[/code] or [code]factory/line_a/state[/code]. The broker payload is interpreted as a raw little-endian scalar matching whichever [code]read_*[/code]/[code]write_*[/code] API is used. Wildcards ([code]+[/code], [code]#[/code]) are not supported. [code]data_type[/code] declares the logical type of the value (one of the [code]TAG_TYPE_*[/code] constants). It is only consulted for the [code]modbus_tcp[/code] protocol, where it determines how many 16-bit registers the value spans (e.g. a [code]TAG_TYPE_FLOAT32[/code] occupies two registers). For every other protocol the type is inferred from whichever [code]read_*[/code]/[code]write_*[/code] method is used and [code]data_type[/code] is ignored.

method.name: register_tag_group
method.description: Register a tag group. Valid values for [code]protocol[/code] are: - [code]ab_eip[/code] - [code]modbus_tcp[/code] - [code]opc_ua[/code] - [code]ads[/code] - [code]rtde[/code] - [code]mqtt[/code] [code]gateway[/code], [code]path[/code] and [code]cpu[/code] are multi-use fields. When the protocol is [code]ab_eip[/code] or [code]modbus_tcp[/code], the [code]gateway[/code] is the IP address of the target device (typically a PLC), the [code]path[/code] is the path (rack/slot) to a processor, and the [code]cpu[/code] may be one of the following values: - [code]ControlLogix[/code] - [code]PLC5[/code] - [code]SLC500[/code] - [code]LogixPccc[/code] - [code]Micro800[/code] - [code]MicroLogix[/code] - [code]Omron[/code] When the protocol is [code]opc_ua[/code], the [code]gateway[/code] is the OPC UA server's endpoint (e.g. [code]opc.tcp://192.168.1.100:4840[/code]). The [code]path[/code] and [code]cpu[/code] fields are not used (the namespace is part of each tag's node ID). When the protocol is [code]ads[/code], the [code]gateway[/code] is the remote PLC's IPv4 address (e.g. [code]192.168.1.10[/code]), the [code]path[/code] is the AmsNetId of the remote runtime (e.g. [code]5.34.142.165.1.1[/code]), and the [code]cpu[/code] is the AMS port as a decimal string ([code]851[/code] for the TwinCAT 3 PLC runtime, [code]801[/code] for TwinCAT 2). Note: a route from the local machine to the remote PLC must be configured on the PLC side first. When the protocol is [code]rtde[/code], the [code]gateway[/code] is the Universal Robots controller's IPv4 address (e.g. [code]192.168.56.101[/code]). The [code]path[/code] and [code]cpu[/code] fields are unused. The [code]polling_interval[/code] is mapped to the controller's RTDE stream frequency ([code]Hz = 1000 / polling_interval[/code]), clamped to [1, 500] Hz. When the protocol is [code]mqtt[/code], the [code]gateway[/code] is the broker host with optional port (e.g. [code]broker.local[/code], [code]192.168.1.50:1883[/code], or [code]tcp://broker:1883[/code]; default port is 1883). The [code]path[/code] is the MQTT client ID (leave empty to auto-generate). The [code]cpu[/code] is optional credentials as [code]user:password[/code]; leave empty for anonymous connection. The MVP is plaintext TCP only; no TLS, retained messages, or QoS > 0.

method.name: set_enable_comms
method.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) the communications. No communication functionality can occur while the simulation is not enabled.

method.name: set_enable_log
method.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) the logging. Note that errors are always logged to the console, and turning on this setting provides additional information.

method.name: set_sim_running
method.description: Inform the [code]OIPComms[/code] singleton that the simulation is running. No communication functionality can occur while the simulation is not running. The only exception is that tag groups, and tags may be registered while the simulation is not running.

method.name: write_bit
method.description: Write a bit (boolean) to the registered [code]tag_name[/code] and [code]tag_group_name[/code]. This operation queues a write operation (either PLC tag or OPC UA client) to be performed on a separate thread. This function returns immediately, regardless if the value is written. Write operations occur immediately on the communication thread and do not wait for a polling interval.

signal.name: comms_error
signal.description: This signal is emitted [i]once[/i]; when the first error occurs in [code]OIPComms[/code]. Subsequent errors will not fire this signal.

signal.name: tag_group_initialized
signal.description: This signal is emitted when a tag group is fully initialized. Currently, [code]OIPComms[/code] will wait 500ms after the simulation starts to start checking if all tags have been registered and connections/sockets are open. Once all tags belonging to the [code]tag_group_name[/code] are initialized, and connected, this signal will emit.

signal.name: tag_group_polled
signal.description: This signal is emitted every time a tag group is polled, based on its [code]polling_interval[/code]. It does not wait until all read operations are complete on that polling interval, the signal fires right away.

signal.name: tag_groups_registered
signal.description: This signal is not emitted by [code]OIPComms[/code], since [code]OIPComms[/code] does not know when all tag groups are registered. It may be emitted externally.

signal.name: enable_comms_changed
signal.description: This signal is emitted every time the comms are enabled or disabled. It is parameterless, and expects that the [code]get_enable_comms()[/code] function will be called to get the comms enabled state.

constants.constant: Boolean value. On modbus this maps to a single coil/discrete or register.
